title: Jonah Elliss will stay at edge rusher

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jonah Elliss will stay at edge rusher
sources.description: One of the big offseason talking points surrounding the Broncos was edge rusher Jonah Elliss potentially moving to inside linebacker. Head coach Sean Payton mentioned he would be “getting some snaps” at linebacker, but never really clarified what that meant. However, Sean Payton did meet with the media after the Broncos’ first OTA practice, which […]
